# Schemas reference

Every JSON document and Arrow table queuetruth writes has a published schema. `queuetruth schema list` lists them
and `queuetruth schema show qt.<name>` prints one. The files are in the repository under `schemas/json/`
(JSON Schema draft 2020-12, generated from the Pydantic models in `queuetruth.schemas`) and `schemas/arrow/`.

## Conventions

| Quantity | Representation |
|---|---|
| Timestamp | integer nanoseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC; Arrow `timestamp[ns, tz=UTC]`; JSON integer |
| Duration | integer nanoseconds; Arrow `int64`; column or field suffix `_ns` |
| Price | `int64` fixed point: real price = `price * 10^price_exp`, `price_exp` per instrument (default `-9`) |
| Size | `uint64` size units: real size = `size * 10^size_exp` (equities `0`, crypto default `-8`) |
| Side | `B` bid or buy, `A` ask or sell, `N` none (Arrow `uint8`); live-log tables use `buy` and `sell` |
| Fees | `float64` in the stated currency; positive is a cost, negative a rebate |
| Ids | `shadow_id`, `order_key`: 1 to 128 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]`; duplicates are an error |
| Undefined price | `UNDEF_PRICE = i64::MAX` only inside `qt.mbo`; every other table uses null |

Every Arrow table carries schema metadata `qt.schema`, `qt.schema_version` and `qt.engine_version`;
`qt.read_table(path, expect="qt.<name>")` checks it. Every JSON document has top-level `schema` and
`schema_version`, contains no NaN or Infinity (null instead), and validates against the JSON Schema of the same
name. Maps keyed by horizon (`{h: v}`) use the horizon in nanoseconds as a decimal string.

The dataset directory written by `ingest`:

```text
<dataset>/
  manifest.json            qt.dataset_manifest
  instruments.parquet      qt.instruments
  mbo/date=YYYY-MM-DD/instrument_id=<id>/part-00000.parquet           qt.mbo (kind mbo)
  l2/date=YYYY-MM-DD/instrument_id=<id>/part-00000.parquet            qt.l2 (kind l2, Tardis input)
  trades_source/date=YYYY-MM-DD/instrument_id=<id>/part-00000.parquet  qt.trades (source prints, for parity)
  data_quality.json        qt.data_quality
```

A partition holds one instrument for one session date, rows in source feed order. The canonical live log is a
directory with `orders.parquet` (`qt.live_orders`), `events.parquet` (`qt.live_events`) and `manifest.json`
(`qt.live_manifest`); see [Import fills from my venue or broker](../how-to/import-live-logs.md).
